name: Night Stalker grants no bonus outdoors in the open world during the day (#1275)
contract: Spell.dbc 807774 triggers 808013 every 10000 ms; 808013 grants +5% damage and +5% healing for 11000 ms.
808013 carries SPELL_ATTR0 0x2000, labelled 'Only usable during nighttime' in SharedDefines.h:459.
Every text source limits the bonus: installed DBC 'at night, while indoors, or in a dungeon'; snapshots 'at night'.
Daytime, outdoors, outside any dungeon is excluded under every reading, so 808013 must never be cast there.
hour 12 starts the case in 12:00-12:59 realm-local time, the Witch Hunter Night() clock; the default human start is outdoors.
Before the fix the parent casts 808013 on its first tick; after the fix the tick is suppressed in daylight.

steps.label: The parent never granted the bonus in daylight
No Night Stalker bonus is active in daylight
